mission_statement: Owner endorses the overall sonic direction; this roster operationalizes it. Specific personnel/reference choices, programs and cue casts remain proposals.
concept: A context-led studio collective of multi-instrumentalist co-composers. Ten core creative members and five guest families choose related instruments and shifting musical roles per song/section; original DKC guides the whole-score architecture.

director.reference: David Wise and Eveline Fischer / original Donkey Kong Country (1994)
director.responsibility: Theme, emotional role, genre contrast, section arc and ownership of the current musical foreground.
director.working_method: Direct context, theme, form and review; invite melodic, harmonic, rhythmic and arranging ideas from all members. Selectively orchestrate their contributions into written songs.

core.function: Context-selected composition and performance roles: foreground hook, chord body, picked ostinato, rhythmic answer.
core.habit: Choose the string instrument and touch that give this cue its emotional center. A picked hook can become a chord figure or a sparse response when another musician takes the theme.
core.uncertainty: If a line wanders, simplify its written hook. If guitar is only background, consider a complete featured phrase or a different register before adding tracks.
core.tone: Rounded string attack and wood/body, with an articulate melodic center.
core.rest: When pan, flute or keys owns the melody, contribute a brief response or leave space.
core.capability_status: Proposed conceptual instrument range. Previously rendered programs listed in uvi; other exact programs/articulations need audition.
core.candidate: Select the exact installed-bank program, instrument-specific articulation and contextual reference for any new instrument or role. Existing verified program evidence is retained in the palette map.

reference_lanes.uncertainty: If the section lacks focus, identify its hook and the instrument delivering it; make the chorus arrival clear through register, harmony and orchestration.

reference_lanes.job: Bright harmonic lift, a buoyant pulse, melodic synth/band exchange and a satisfying return.
reference_lanes.uncertainty: If energy feels flat, change harmonic rhythm, bass movement or sectional texture before simply increasing loudness.

seating_limit: Ten core members are capabilities to cast from. Most sections use a selected subset; foreground, groove leadership, supporting functions and rests can rotate. Existing family lists are options, not requirements.
reference_policy: Per-member anchors provide creative vocabulary; choose the instrument- and context-appropriate reference for each decision. Multiple references are allowed for every member. Proposed goals do not assert real artist participation or completed listening/transcription.
program_policy: UVI soundkits and explicitly requested Sunbird remain the general instrument family. Owner explicitly authorizes RetroPlug/LSDJ as the exception for the authentic Game Boy/chiptune lane; Ember King’s theme is chiptune. New program choices still require audition; no other non-UVI instruments are authorized by this exception.
producer_material: Original performances on licensed UVI instruments, including dedicated electronic lead/bass/chord parts and our own band stems. Preserve dry source, edit and processed part separately. Reference recordings and ROM/sample rips do not become soundtrack material. The owner-authorized RetroPlug/LSDJ lane adds original Game Boy performances and editable song/stem sources; software/ROMs remain private.
runtime_scope: Studio composition and flattened cue delivery; no new runtime DJ or adaptive audio system.
release_scope: Studies/proposals only; demo freeze, human, voice, phone, child and release acceptance remain separate.
collaboration_policy: Members can originate hooks, grooves, harmony proposals and formal ideas. Instrument choice and audible function are selected for the cue; no member is locked to melody, accompaniment or texture.
physical_policy: Name the instrument and player active in a section. Simultaneous incompatible instruments require another player or declared studio overdub; playing idioms remain instrument-specific.

rhythmic_foundation.owner_direction: Lo-fi beats are the underlying theme for the current time; add traditional/world percussion, with metal-style drum kits excluded from the current default palette.
rhythmic_foundation.reference_status: Nujabes / J Dilla track choices proposed for review.
rhythmic_foundation.orchestration: Producer, acoustic drummer or either percussion member may lead the groove; the others take complementary roles or rest.
rhythmic_foundation.groove: Choose intentional placement and swing where it serves the song; acoustic and ambient cues can express this through sparse pulse or space.
rhythmic_foundation.fidelity: Preserve warm body, note identity and clean masters. Hiss, pitch drift and bit reduction are optional designed colors; exact treatments require audition.
rhythmic_foundation.kit_readiness: Existing brushed Jazzistic and UVI percussion programs verified. Owner reports world kits; select exact world/BBA programs before production use.
